drawabox_cost_note: Lessons and challenges are free to read (search-result evidence; no research pass could open drawabox.com). Official critique is paid with Patreon credits that expire after two months; 2024 posts give 1 credit for Lessons 1 and 2 and the box, cylinder and wheel challenges, and 2 credits for Lessons 3 to 7 and the texture and chest challenges, and the site says these amounts can change. Community critique on drawabox.com, r/ArtFundamentals and the Discord is free but not guaranteed.

https://drawabox.com/lesson/0/2/50percen.notes: Drawabox's rule of thumb: at most half your drawing time on study, at least half drawing for its own sake. A useful frame for the weekly split between module work and invention (search-result evidence; not opened).

https://drawabox.com/lesson/0/3/gettingt.notes: Drawabox's advice on getting the most out of the course. Search results did not summarise its contents, so read it before relying on it.

https://drawabox.com/lesson/0/3/gettingf.notes: How Drawabox handles feedback: free community critique that is not guaranteed, and paid official critique. Read it to decide whether and where to ask for critique (search-result evidence; not opened).

https://drawabox.com/lesson/0/5.notes: Drawabox's tool list for its own exercises: 0.5 fineliners and plain printer paper, with ballpoint accepted for Lesson 1 and the box challenge. A better fit for kit questions than the recommendations page (search-result evidence; not opened).

persp-ellipses-cylinders|https://drawabo.notes: The 250 cylinder challenge: 150 cylinders around arbitrary minor axes, then 100 in boxes. Spread it over weeks as warm-ups once ellipses in perspective make sense. Only this stage-2 page was seen in search results.

persp-construct-primitives|https://drawa.notes: The 250 cylinder challenge (search-result evidence). Drawabox suggests doing it between its Lessons 5 and 6; use it here as ongoing warm-ups for cylinders in boxes.

persp-ellipses-cylinders|https://drawabo.notes: The 25 wheel challenge: wheels from reference, ideally with an ellipse guide. Drawabox places it after Lesson 6, so treat it as a later stretch for this module (search-result evidence).

nat-hard-surface-vehicles-machines|https.notes: The 25 wheel challenge, which Drawabox places between its everyday-objects and vehicles lessons. Do it before drawing vehicles (search-result evidence; not opened).

https://drawabox.com/lesson/25textures/1.notes: The optional 25 texture challenge: rows of texture analysis implied with filled cast-shadow shapes, spread over a long period (search-result evidence; not opened).

nat-everyday-objects|https://drawabox.co.notes: The optional 100 treasure chest challenge, after Drawabox's Lesson 6. A long box-construction project for when everyday objects feel steady (search-result evidence).

persp-construct-primitives|https://drawa.notes: The optional 100 treasure chest challenge. Its prerequisites run through Drawabox Lesson 6, so save it for later (search-result evidence).
